data.title: Benin face Central African Republic with 2027 Africa Cup of Nations hopes at stake - Ghana Latest Football News, Live Sc
data.content:
The Fauves have endured a difficult start, losing 3-1 to Mauritania in their opening match before suffering a 1-0 defeat by Burkina Faso. They now have little room for further mistakes if they are to revive their qualifying campaign.

Benin will be without captain Steve Mounie, who remains unavailable because of injury. They can, however, call on Junior Olaitan, who has recorded three goals and seven assists for Besiktas. [...] Benin sit top of Group F with four points from their opening two matches. The Guepards began with a 1-1 draw away to Burkina Faso before beating Mauritania 2-1.

That leaves them level on points with Burkina Faso, who play Mauritania on Friday. Benin, who reached the last 16 at the previous Africa Cup of Nations, are unbeaten in qualifying and will be looking to extend that run against a Central African Republic side without a point. [...] Edwin Quarshie is suspended after accumulating yellow cards. The Central African Republic, who are still seeking their first appearance at the Africa Cup of Nations, must now begin their recovery under a new coach and against the group leaders.
